feat_text: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
This adversary can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

When you spotlight this adversary and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight this adversary and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.
When this adversary makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.
This adversary is resistant to magic damage.
This adversary is resistant to physical damage.

When you spotlight the {adversary} and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight the {adversary} and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.
You must spend a Fear to spotlight the {adversary}. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.
The {adversary}’s attacks deal direct damage.
Targets who take damage from the {adversary}’s standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.
On a successful standard attack, mark a Stress to give the target the Restrained condition until they break free with a successful Action Roll or other appropriate action.

Spend a Fear to send the {adversary} into a blind rage; they can make <<tier>> attacks against targets within Close range and deal <<2x dmg>> physical damage on a successful attack. After the rage, the {adversary} is temporarily Vulnerable.
Mark a Stress to have the {adversary} make a standard attack. On a success, the attack’s force renders the target Vulnerable until they mark a Stress or gain a Hope.

Mark a Stress to have the {adversary} charge in a line within Close range and swing wildly at all targets in their path. Any targets within Melee range of the path must succeed on an Agility or Strength Reaction Roll or take <<1x dmg>> physical damage and be knocked back to Very Close range.

Mark a Stress to have the {adversary} pick up and throw a huge object at a point or target within Close range. Anyone within Melee range of the point/target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take <<1.5x dmg>> physical damage and be knocked back to Very Close range.

Make an attack against a target within Melee range; instead of dealing damage, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until the {adversary} marks 2 or more HP or the target succeeds on a Strength Action Roll.
When the {adversary} makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

When the {adversary} marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a Stress to immediately activate Frenzied Rage: (Spend a Fear to send the {adversary} into a blind rage; they can make <<tier>> attacks against targets within Close range and deal <<2x dmg>> physical damage on a successful attack. After the rage, the {adversary} is temporarily Vulnerable.)

feat_name: Quick to Act, Slow to Think
feat_text: When another adversary Restrains a target within Close range of the {adversary}, you can mark a Stress to have the {adversary} make a standard attack with advantage that targets both the target and the restraining adversary.
When the {Horde} have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals <<0.5x dmg>> physical damage instead.

At your choosing, the {Horde} can break out into Minions of an appropriate type, creating <<perhp>> Minions for each 1 HP converted. As Minions, each gains the Minion (<<perhp>>) Passive feature (use an existing Minion value if they are already in the scene; if not, for each <<perhp>> damage received another Minion within range is defeated) and the Group Attack Action feature (Spend a Fear to highlight all Minions within range of a chosen Minion. Move into Melee range of a target and make one shared attack roll, dealing <<0.5x exp_dmg -2>> physical damage per Minion involved).
The {adversary} can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
Spend a Fear to make 2 standard attacks on a single target in Close range, or 1 standard attack on each of 2 targets in Close range.
Spend a Fear to make 1d4+1 standard attacks against targets in Close range.
The {adversary} can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
The {adversary} can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
Adversaries within Very Close range of the {adversary} can add <<tier -1>>d4 to their damage rolls.
Summon as many Minions as there are party members; the Minions appear at Far range.
Spend a Fear to spotlight up to three {adversaries} within Far range of the {adversary}.
The {adversary} can make a standard attack and spotlight up to 1d4 + <<tier>> {adversaries} within Far range if they have used a previous action to ready this spotlight.
Mark 2 Stress to have the {adversary} inspire all adversaries within Close range; all adversaries within Far range can clear 1 Stress. You can spend a Fear to also have each adversary clear 1 HP.
Mark a Stress to spotlight up to 1d4 adversaries within Far range, who all make a standard attack. Successful attacks deal half damage.
Spend a Fear to have the {adversary} indicate a target within Far range to their allies; the target is Vulnerable for the next adversary attack.

When the {adversary} marks 2 or more HP, you can immediately spotlight them to direct all adversaries within Close range to their location, standing between the {adversary} and any opponents. Attacks against the {adversary} have disadvantage until at least one adversary is defeated or moved beyond Melee range from the {adversary}.
When the {adversary} makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
When an adversary within sight of the {adversary} misses on an attack, you can spend a Fear to have the {adversary} berate their underlings. The next 1d4 adversary attacks are made with advantage.
The {Minion} is defeated when they take any damage. For every <<minion_pasv>> damage a PC deals to the {Minion}, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all {Minions} within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal <<1x exp_dmg>> physical damage each. Combine this damage.

At your choosing, the {Minions} can join to form a Horde of the appropriate type, with the Horde gaining 1 HP per <<tier +1>> Minions (use reasonable whole numbers as needed). Minions can form a new Horde or join an existing one to add to its HP. A Horde created this way has the Horde (<<dmg +2>>) Passive feature. When the Horde has more than half its starting HP, a standard attack deals <<2x dmg +3>> physical damage; when the Horde is at half HP or less, its standard attack deals <<dmg +2>>  damage.

Spend a Fear to have all {Ranged} prepare a ranged attack; when you spotlight the {Ranged} immediately after spending Fear, describe how they are readying an attack and end their spotlight. The next time you spotlight the {Ranged}, have each {Ranged} make a standard attack against a target within range.

Mark a Stress to have the {adversary} direct a continuous volley covering the Close range extending outward from a target. Any PC within or crossing through the affected area must succeed on an Agility Roll or take <<0.5x exp_dmg>> physical damage.
Spend a Fear to make an attack with advantage.
Mark a Stress to make make an additional standard attack.
Mark a Stress and make a standard attack; on a success, add an additional die to the damage roll, or add <<2x tier>> if using average damage.

If the {adversary} marks 1 or more HP from an attack made from Close range or farther, you can mark a Stress to have them immediately make a standard attack with disadvantage against their attacker or another PC within Very Close range of their attacker.
The {adversary} is Hidden if they are further than Very Close range of a PC.
If the {adversary} moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (<<2x tier 13>>) or else mark a Stress.
Become Hidden until after the {adversary}’s next attack. Attacks made while Hidden from this feature have advantage.
Make a standard attack; on a success, the target is Vulnerable until they clear at least 1 HP.
Spend a Fear to make a standard attack and have the {adversary} immediately move up to Close range and become Hidden.

When the {adversary} marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a stress to have them signal to other {adversary}s in the scene; describe the haunting sounds that answer back and have all PCs within Close range of the attacked {adversary} mark a Stress.

If the {adversary} makes a successful standard attack and there is another {adversary} within Melee range of the target, the other {adversary} may immediately make a standard attack for <<0.5x dmg>> damage and you gain a Fear.
The {adversary}’s difficulty increases by <<tier>> for rolls against them using Presence.
Spend a Fear to antagonize a PC; the PC must succeed on a Presence Roll (<<2x tier +13>>) or else mark 2 Stress.

feat_name: Don’t You Know Who I AM?!
feat_text: When a PC succeeds on an attack against the {adversary}, you can mark a Stress to have the {adversary} summon 1d4+1 henchmen, who appear at Far range.
You can heckle a PC who has recently made a roll with Hope; they must succeed on an Instinct Roll (<<2x tier +13>>) or had disadvantage on their next Action Roll.

When you spotlight the {adversary} and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight the {adversary} and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.
The {adversary} can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
The {adversary} can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
The {adversary} has advantage on attacks against a target with no allies in Melee or Very Close range.
On a successful standard attack, mark a Stress to give the target the Restrained condition until they break free with a successful action roll.
Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against up to 1d4 targets within Very Close range.

Spend a Fear to introduce a force that pulls 1d4 targets within Close range into Melee range of the {adversary}; the force can be magical or physical (e.g. a magical construct or a grappling weapon). If a target is hiding behind an object that could reasonably be damaged, the object is destroyed and the target is not moved.

feat_name: A Foe Beyond Any of You
feat_text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all PCs within Close range; on a successful attack, the target must mark 2 Stress or lose a Hope.
Mark a Stress to make an attack; on a success, the target must mark two Armor Slots to reduce marked HP by 1.

Spend a Fear to clear all Stress; until the {adversary} marks at least one Stress, they reduce all incoming damage by <<tier>>d4. The <adversary> becomes temporarily Vulnerable as soon as they mark 1 or more Stress after using this feature.

Countdown (Loop 1d4). The {adversary} evaluates their opponents carefully; when the countdown is at 1, the next time a PC makes a roll with Fear you can immediately spotlight the {adversary} and make two standard attacks against targets within range.
When the {adversary} is caused to mark at least one Stress, roll a d6; on a 5 or 6, they mark no Stress.
When the {adversary} marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a Stress to have them immediately make an attack at disadvantage.
When the {adversary} makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
When the {adversary} has 1 HP remaining, they make all attacks with advantage.
When the {adversary} is within Melee range of a creature and at least one other {adversary} is within Close range, all attacks against that creature have advantage.

If the {adversary} makes a successful standard attack and another {adversary} is within Melee range of the target, deal <<dmg>>+<<5x tier>> physical damage instead of their standard damage and you gain a Fear.

A creature who tries to move within Very Close range of the {adversary} must succeed on an Agility Roll. The Difficulty increases by the number of {same-type adversaries} within Melee range of the {adversary}.
Mark a Stress to make a standard attack and add <<tier>>d4 to the damage.
When the {adversary} is defeated, any one adversary of the same type within Close range of the defeated {adversary} and not in Melee range of a PC can immediately move to the defeated {adversary}.

Mark a Stress to make an attack projecting a harmful aura (magic) or noxious substance (physical) at a target within Close range; on a success, the target is Vulnerable until they mark a Stress or gain a Hope.
Spend a Fear to make a standard attack; on a success, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they make a successful Trait Roll.
Spend a Fear to have the {adversary} coat a creature’s weapon with a smoky, smoldering coating; attacks made with the weapon apply direct damage.

Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the {adversary} succeeds against become Restrained and Vulnerable {for a fiction-following reason}. A target can break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Trait Roll.
Mark a Stress to Embolden another creature; its next attack is made with advantage.
Spend a Fear to clear 1 HP from another creature.
Mark a Stress to clear 2 Stress from another creature.
Spend a Fear to clear 2 Stress from all targets within Close range.
When a PC fails with Fear on an action roll, clear 1 HP.
When <the colossus> fails an attack, you gain a Fear.

Spend a Fear and start a Countdown (Loop 1d6); describe how the <the colossus> becomes increasingly agitated as you decrease the countdown by 1 for each Action Roll (by an adversary or the party). When the countdown reaches zero, <the colossus> lashes out in a wild frenzy of motion. Make <tier> attacks against individual targets within range using segments of your choosing. <The colossus> is temporarily Vulnerable until it marks at least 1 HP.

Spend a Fear and make an attack roll with a segment of your choice against all targets within Close range and roll 3d<<tierside_left>> to project a (fiction-fitting) burst of physical or magic projectiles; damage for targets the attack succeeds against varies by the target’s proximity to the attacking segment. Those within Melee range take 3d<<tierside_left>>+<<square_tier>> damage (magic or physical, as fits the fiction); those within Very Close range take 2d<<tierside_left>>+<<square_tier>> damage (remove one of the dice); those within Close range take 1d<<tierside_left>>+<<square_tier>> damage (remove two of the dice).
When <the colossus segment> succeeds on an attack, all creatures within Very Close distance to the target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take <<tier>>d6 damage.

Spend a Fear to give <the colossus segment> advantage on an attack roll against a flying target within range. On a success, the target must succeed on a Strength or Agility Reaction Roll or else they are knocked to Close range and are rendered Vulnerable until they succeed or roll with Hope.

Spend a Fear to have <the colossus segment> attack a target within range that is on the ground. On a success add <<tier>>d8 to the standard attack damage roll. Whether a success or miss, describe how the ground within Close range of the attack is rendered difficult to traverse as a consequence of the attack.

If one <colossus segment> is Destroyed, <the colossus> is temporarily brought to the ground, allowing PCs to climb onto otherwise higher-up segments. If (GM: choose an appropriate number up to the total count) <colossus segments> are Destroyed, <the colossus> is permanently brought to the ground.
When <the colossus segment> succeeds on an attack, all creatures within Very Close distance to the target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take <<tier>>d4 damage.

Spend a Fear to give <the colossus segment> advantage on an attack roll against a flying target within range. On a success, the target must succeed on a Strength or Agility Reaction Roll or else they are knocked to Close range and are rendered Vulnerable until they succeed or roll with Hope.

Spend a Fear to have <the colossus segment> attack a target within range that is on the ground. On a success add <<tier>>d6 to the standard attack damage roll. Whether a success or miss, describe how the ground within Close range of the attack is rendered difficult to traverse as a consequence of the attack.

If one <colossus segment> is Destroyed, <the colossus> is temporarily brought to the ground, allowing PCs to climb onto otherwise higher-up segments. If (GM: choose an appropriate number up to the total count) <colossus segments> are Destroyed, <the colossus> is permanently brought to the ground.
